title: Lost Luggage
paragraphs: Halfway through her connecting flight home, Zahra realized with growing worry that her suitcase had not been transferred to the second plane, meaning it was probably still sitting somewhere in the previous airport.

At the arrivals desk, she calmly explained the situation to the airline staff, who assured her the bag would arrive on the next available flight and be delivered directly to her address within two days.

While waiting, Zahra had to borrow clothes from her sister and repurchase a few basic items, which was mildly frustrating but far from a disaster compared to what she had originally feared might happen.
When the suitcase finally arrived exactly as promised, Zahra realized that staying calm and patient throughout the process had made the whole situation far easier to manage than panicking would have.
